title: The Housemaid
author: Freida McFadden
summary: A woman desperate for work takes a live-in job cleaning for a wealthy family in a perfect house. Things quickly feel wrong, as the wife behaves unpredictably and the husband appears kind, but she is not telling the full story either.
readIf: you want a quick, twisty, addictive thriller with a narrator you will second-guess.
skipIf: you want realistic characters or dislike thrillers that rely on sharp reversals.

pairings.reason: A more intricate and literary thriller built on the same distrust of who is telling the truth.
Another fast, twisty read narrated by a troubled woman who is not entirely reliable.
A more character-driven look at what hides behind polished domestic lives.
